name: z-agent
description: 中文优先、可审计的长程智能体桌面应用

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ui,desktop -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @zagent/ui" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run dev -w @zagent/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run package -w @zagent/desktop
scripts.lint:core: conda run --prefix .conda/envs/zagent ruff check src tests
scripts.test: npm run lint:core && npm run test:core && npm run test -w @zagent/ui && npm run typecheck -w @zagent/ui
